1. Verdict

On the locked test window (18:05:00-23:59:59), market_making strategy mm_calm_double on SOLUSDT_PERP (liquidity & flow) lost 13.0 bps/hour net under the risk-averse queue model, the worse of the two (too few blocks to say for an interval), at a Sharpe its holds leave too few blocks to measure; -10.1 before the 2 bps maker fee; not viable as a maker: the fee is 4.7 times the half spread of 0.42 bps and the fills gave back 4.3 times the half spread within 10 s.

Judged under rules v3.

Fee verdict: too few blocks to say. The pass holds 1 blocks of 168422 steps, fewer than the 20 the Ladder needs to release a strategy, so no interval is claimed; the break-even maker fee, where the mean net is zero, is -10.75 bps.

The fills are the strategy as written: a strategy built for a rebate would quote differently.

3. Deflation

A naive run scores whatever window the agent asks for, so it has no validation blocks to deflate with. The protected run beside it does the deflation.

4. The signal

Shown on train, validation and test, by edge and then by archetype. Each archetype's pick is the rule of a families run kept to its own trials: the final strategy's, else the last released, else the best on validation. Test appears only when the final strategy was scored there.

Speed & information: paid for reaching a price first

Paid for reaching a price first. The other side is a stale quote or a slower reader, and the race only gets faster.

order_book_imbalance: Order-book imbalance

The feature: obi_change_z (trial 21), the accepted feature with the largest rank IC on the window it was scored on

Every time the feature went past its 5th or 95th percentile on train counts as a trade in the direction it predicts. Events are at least 70 s apart, so no two paths share a second of price and the standard error is a fair one. The thick line is the average mid move in the trade's direction, from 10 s before the decision to 60 s after, and the band is two standard errors either side; it widens as single paths drift apart. Longs and shorts are drawn separately, to show a signal that works in one direction only. Left of zero is how the price got there. The dotted line is the fill, the latency plus the feed delay after the decision. A taker who fills there and crosses the spread again to get out needs the line above the dashed one, and above the dash-dot one once fees are paid.

The strategy: mm_calm_double (trial 45), the final strategy

Four fill models, each its own closed loop on the recorded book and trades: T fills only when a trade goes through the quote, RA joins the back of the displayed size and takes every cancel as behind it, PR takes cancels from ahead of it in proportion, and F is always at the front. Every number is in bps of one unit at the first mid of the segment. The judge scores the lower of RA's and PR's Sharpe in the score's column, each measured on blocks at least as long as that model's time-weighted mean hold, since one hold is one bet however many blocks it spans; the column before it is the same P&L on the brief's 5 min blocks.

On train the rule took RA: its Sharpe measures nothing (fewer than two of its blocks, or a P&L that never moved), and a pass with no number is the worse. On validation the rule took RA: its Sharpe measures nothing (fewer than two of its blocks, or a P&L that never moved), and a pass with no number is the worse. RA held its inventory 3 h 37 min 2 s on average, so validation holds 1 of its blocks, fewer than 20: the Ladder was given no score, and the strategy could not be released. On test the rule took RA: its Sharpe measures nothing (fewer than two of its blocks, or a P&L that never moved), and a pass with no number is the worse. On the brief's 5 min blocks PR is the lower (-0.3227 against -0.3227); the score does not use those, because RA's holds outlast them. T and F bracket the fill count, not the P&L: reality's fill count lies between T and F, and its P&L is not bounded by any row.

The half hour of the last segment with the most fills of the scored model: the touch, the quotes resting in it, each fill, and the inventory below.

After each fill: the mid's move in the fill's direction, weighted by units, for each model. A maker's fill sits below the mid at 0 by what it captured, and pays the fee; the line has to stay above the break-even for the fill to pay. Lines that fall after 0 are adverse selection.

How it dies. Adverse selection. You get filled most just before the price moves against you. Faster makers take the front of the queue, and a fee change can erase the margin.

mm_calm_double
import blinded as bl
import polars as pl

x = bl.market_making(instrument="SOLUSDT_PERP")


@x.strategy(requires=["mm_lean_depl"])
def mm_calm_tight(panel, features):
    f = features["mm_lean_depl"]
    ok = pl.when(f.abs() < 0.1).then(0).otherwise(None)
    return bl.quote(bid=ok, ask=ok, size=0.5, skew=1.0, max_inventory=1.0)


@x.strategy(requires=["mm_lean_depl", "mm_queue_depl"])
def mm_calm_double(panel, features):
    f = features["mm_lean_depl"]
    q = features["mm_queue_depl"]
    ok = pl.when((f.abs() < 0.25) & (q.abs() < 0.1)).then(0).otherwise(None)
    return bl.quote(bid=ok, ask=ok, size=0.5, skew=1.0, max_inventory=1.0)


@x.strategy(requires=["mm_lean_depl"])
def mm_calm_skew3(panel, features):
    f = features["mm_lean_depl"]
    ok = pl.when(f.abs() < 0.25).then(0).otherwise(None)
    return bl.quote(bid=ok, ask=ok, size=0.3, skew=3.0, max_inventory=0.6)
mm_queue_depl
import blinded as bl
from blinded import features as F
import polars as pl

x = bl.market_making(instrument="SOLUSDT_PERP")
S = "SOLUSDT_PERP"


@x.feature("bid-queue depletion minus ask-queue depletion: a touch queue shrinking faster than the other side gives way first")
def mm_queue_depl(panel):
    b = pl.col(f"{S}.bid_qty").log1p()
    a = pl.col(f"{S}.ask_qty").log1p()
    d = (b - a)
    return F.ewm_mean(d, 3) - F.ewm_mean(d, 50)


@x.feature("mid below its 2s ewm in bps: short-horizon tick reversion of the mid toward where passive fills occur")
def mm_mid_revert(panel):
    m = F.mid(S)
    return (F.ewm_mean(m, 20) - m) / m * 1e4


@x.feature("microprice deviation scaled by recent quote activity: a lean is more informative when the book is churning")
def mm_micro_active(panel):
    q = F.quote_rate(S, "2s")
    qs = F.ewm_mean(q, 600)
    return F.ewm_mean(F.micro_minus_mid(S, bps=True), 5) * (q / qs).clip(0, 5).fill_null(1.0)
mm_lean_depl
import blinded as bl
from blinded import features as F
import polars as pl

x = bl.market_making(instrument="SOLUSDT_PERP")
S = "SOLUSDT_PERP"


@x.feature("microprice lean scaled up when the touch is thin: a lean on a small queue resolves sooner, so quotes on the far side are toxic")
def mm_micro_thin(panel):
    tot = pl.col(f"{S}.bid_qty") + pl.col(f"{S}.ask_qty")
    thin = (F.ewm_mean(tot, 600) / (tot + 1e-9)).clip(0.25, 4.0)
    return F.ewm_mean(F.micro_minus_mid(S, bps=True), 5) * thin


@x.feature("microprice lean plus queue-depletion, each standardised by trailing std: the two best leads summed")
def mm_lean_depl(panel):
    d = pl.col(f"{S}.bid_qty").log1p() - pl.col(f"{S}.ask_qty").log1p()
    a = F.ewm_mean(d, 3) - F.ewm_mean(d, 50)
    m = F.ewm_mean(F.micro_minus_mid(S, bps=True), 5)
    return a / (F.ewm_std(a, 3000) + 1e-9) + m / (F.ewm_std(m, 3000) + 1e-9)


@x.feature("mean signed size per trade over 5s: block aggression is informed, unlike count-weighted imbalance")
def mm_block_flow(panel):
    sv = F.signed_volume(S, "5s")
    n = F.trade_count(S, "5s")
    return F.ewm_mean(sv / (n + 1.0), 5)

# NOTES
## Session 1 (speed & information), train window
- Submitted 1 obi_weighted (5-level 1/(k+1) weighted imbalance, ewm10): rankIC 1s 0.19, 10s 0.15.
- 2 obi_change (ewm3-ewm50 of touch imbalance): rankIC 100ms 0.14, 1s 0.27, 10s 0.18. Best so far.
- 3 flow_30s (30s trade_imbalance): rankIC ~0.01-0.02, weak; slow trade-sign flow adds little at 10s.
- Caveat: markout_bps tiny (0.1-0.4bp) vs 1-tick spread (0.85bp)+fee: taking likely loses; use thresholds/low turnover.
- Next: shorter-window trade flow (1-3s), flow x imbalance agreement, imbalance change on deep book.

## Session 2 (liquidity & flow, market_making), train window
- 4 mm_flow_2s (2s trade_imbalance): rankIC 1s 0.087, 10s 0.051. Modest.
- 5 mm_micro_dev (ewm5 microprice-mid bps): rankIC 1s 0.255, 10s 0.187, 60s 0.08; best, low turnover. Use as quote lean/fair.
- 6 mm_imb_flow (touch imbalance x 1s flow): ~0.01-0.02, useless; product dilutes.
- Next: quote-strategy features (toxicity: quote_rate/volatility for widening/withdrawal), inventory-aware skew, deeper depth_imbalance.

## Session 3 (speed & information), train window
- 7 obi_deep_change (5-level depth imbalance ewm3-ewm50): rankIC 1s 0.207, 10s 0.157; below touch obi_change (0.27) - deeper levels dilute.
- 8 flow_1s (ewm5 of 1s trade_imbalance): 1s 0.078, 10s 0.049. 9 flow_accel (5s-30s): 1s 0.076, 10s 0.048. Trade flow is weak (<0.08) vs book imbalance; ~no signal at 60s.
- Book imbalance dynamics (touch obi_change, mm_micro_dev) dominate; flow is secondary. Next: combos of touch obi_change with spread/volatility regime, imbalance change at different ewm pairs (1/10), queue depletion asymmetry (bid0_qty vs ask0_qty change).

## Session 4 (liquidity & flow, market_making), train window
- 10 mm_queue_depl (ewm3-ewm50 of log1p(bid_qty)-log1p(ask_qty); first try errored: panel cols are SYM.bid_qty not bid0_qty): rankIC 100ms 0.149, 1s 0.273, 10s 0.181, 60s 0.08. Ties obi_change as best.
- 11 mm_mid_revert (ewm20 mid - mid, bps): NEGATIVE rankIC (-0.117 at 1s): mid momentum continues, not reverts; flip sign if used, but weak.
- 12 mm_micro_active (micro_dev x quote_rate/ewm600 rate): 1s 0.244, 10s 0.169; no better than plain mm_micro_dev (0.255) - activity scaling adds nothing.
- Takeaway: queue/book-imbalance dynamics saturate ~0.27 at 1s. Markouts still <0.4bp vs 2bp maker fee in brief -> strategies phase must check fee/rebate rows.
- Next: spread/vol regime gating (widen when realized_vol high), inventory-skew is strategy-level.

## Session 5 (speed & information), train window
- 15 obi_change_fast (ewm1-ewm10 imbalance): 1s 0.265, 10s 0.162; no better than obi_change (0.27), higher turnover 0.11.
- 16 micro_change (ewm3-ewm50 micro_minus_mid): 1s 0.271, 10s 0.182, 60s 0.081; ties best, turnover 0.05.
- 17 flow_3s_norm (ewm10 of 3s trade_imbalance): 1s 0.070, 10s 0.047; flow again weak (name misleading, no normalisation).
- Saturated: every book-imbalance variant lands ~0.27 at 1s. Little left in features; edge gains must come from strategy (thresholds, low turnover).

## Session 6 (liquidity & flow, market_making), train window
- 18 mm_micro_thin (micro_dev x thin-touch factor): 1s 0.251, 10s 0.183; no gain over plain micro_dev.
- 19 mm_lean_depl (std-normalised micro_dev + queue_depl): 1s 0.285, 10s 0.197, 60s 0.085, turnover 0.04; best single feature so far (small gain from combining).
- 20 mm_block_flow (signed size per trade, 5s): 1s 0.054; flow still weak.
- Features saturated (~0.27-0.29 at 1s). Remaining value is in strategies (quote lean/skew, fee check). phase_done true.

## Session 7 (speed & information), train window
- 21 obi_change_z (obi_change / ewm_std of imbalance): 1s 0.270, 10s 0.183; same as obi_change, no gain.
- 22 mid_momentum (ewm5-ewm20 mid bps): 1s 0.089, 10s 0.037; weak (own-price momentum is not the info).
- 23 burst_flow (10s flow x trade intensity ratio): 1s 0.053, 60s ~0; flow still weak.
- Confirmed saturated: book-imbalance ~0.27, flow <0.09. phase_done true; work is in strategies (thresholds, low turnover, fees).

## Session 8 (liquidity & flow, market_making), train window
- 24 mm_flow_vs_queue (1s signed volume / touch size, ewm5): 1s 0.095, 10s 0.057; flow still weak even normalised by queue.
- 25 mm_second_level (level-1 queue log-ratio, ewm3-ewm50): 1s 0.187, 10s 0.135; below touch queue_depl (0.27); deeper queues carry less.
- Nothing beat mm_lean_depl (0.285). Features saturated; phase_done true.

## Session 9 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 26 micro_change_wide (threshold z_in 3, z_out .5 on micro_change): 76 fills, gross +0.09bp/fill, net -4.9bp/fill at 5bp taker fee; SR -1.6. Fees 0 SR +0.35.
- 27 obi_flow_agree (obi_change gated by flow_1s sign, z_in 2.5): 2622 fills, gross -0.11bp/fill, SR -7.6. Flow gating adds churn, no edge.
- 28 flow_slow_lin (flow_accel threshold z 3): never trades (0 fills); flow_accel z-scaling too tight/ineffective.
- Takeaway: 5bp taker fee vs <0.4bp moves: no taking strategy can pay. Gross per fill is ~0.1bp. Directional speed strategies are dead here; only a maker route could work (liquidity edge). phase_done true.

## Session 10 (liquidity & flow, strategies), train window
- Submitted 3 MM quote strategies gated by mm_lean_depl (withdraw side that would be adverse): mm_sel_side (quote only favoured side, thr 1), mm_both_unless_adverse (both, withdraw adverse, thr .5), mm_far_passive (thr 2, max_inv 1).
- All lose at the 2bp maker fee: net SR -0.8, -2.9, -0.9 (worse queue model). Gross/fill -0.8, -0.6, -0.1bp; fee 2bp/fill dominates a 0.85bp tick. Only mm_far_passive at 0.5bp rebate is positive (+0.29bp/fill, SR 0.2, 292 fills): not worth it at the brief fee.
- Selective withdrawal reduces fills but not adverse selection; fewer, more-selective fills (far_passive) get gross to ~0. Maker fee kills everything; no maker route is profitable at 2bp.
- Next: stricter thresholds (thr 3+), only if gross/fill can exceed 2bp; likely not. phase_done true.

## Session 11 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 35 lean_depl_hold (mm_lean_depl z_in 4, z_out 0) and 36 obi_z_extreme (obi_change_z z_in 5, z_out 2): 0 fills; z-scaling by trailing std makes z>=4-5 unreachable. Use z_in<=3.
- 37 block_flow_hold (mm_block_flow z_in 3, z_out 0): 200 fills, gross +1.4bp/fill, net -3.6bp at 5bp fee, SR -1.0 (fees 0: +0.48). Best gross/fill yet but still < fee.
- Taking cannot pay 5bp; gross per fill tops ~1.4bp. phase_done true.

## Session 12 (liquidity & flow, strategies), train window
- 38 mm_calm_both (quote both sides at touch only when |mm_lean_depl|<0.25, size .5, skew 1, max_inv 1): net +3.3 bps/h (RA), PR -2.2; fees 0 +6.1; only brief-fee-positive MM so far, but tiny/near zero. Idea: quote only when the book is neutral (no adverse lean), not on lean.
- 39 mm_lean_shift (lean=clip(f,±2) ticks, both sides at touch): -210 bps/h; shifting quotes with signal is bad. 40 mm_back_of_queue (join favoured side, 1 tick behind otherwise, withdraw adverse): -161 bps/h.
- Takeaway: calm-gating beats lean-gating; aggressive lean/joining loses. Next: tighten calm gate (|f|<0.1), add vol/spread/activity gate, test on val.

## Session 13 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 41 lean_depl_slow (mm_lean_depl z_in 3, z_out 1.5) and 42 lean_block_confirm (lean x block_flow agree, z_in 3): 0 fills; z>=3 on lean_depl is unreachable (its std scaling already unit). Use z_in<=2.5.
- 43 block_flow_lin (bl.linear on mm_block_flow): 60k fills, gross -0.04bp/fill, net -3364 bps/h, SR -14.8. Linear sizing churns; never use linear on a taker.
- Taking still dead at 5bp fee. Nothing left worth trying; phase_done true.

## Session 14 (liquidity & flow, strategies), window all
- 44 mm_calm_tight (|lean_depl|<0.1): -4.2 bps/h; too few fills, fee dominates. 46 mm_calm_skew3 (size .3, skew 3, max_inv .6): -6.7.
- 45 mm_calm_double (|lean_depl|<0.25 AND |mm_queue_depl|<0.1, both at touch, size .5, skew 1): +13.0 bps/h worse-model (RA), fees-0 16.2; best MM so far, positive at the 2bp fee. Two-signal calm gate beats one.
- Next: add a third calm condition (spread/vol/flow), check val/test split of 45, avoid tightening single gate.

## Session 15 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 47 flow_5m (5m trade_imbalance): rankIC ~0.007 at 1s, 0.02 at 60s; no persistence signal. 48 flow_5m_hold (z_in 2, z_out .5): SR -0.7, loses at 5bp taker fee.
- 49 lean_depl_mid (mm_lean_depl z_in 2.5): 0 fills again; lean_depl z-scaling makes even 2.5 unreachable. Use z_in<=2 or avoid.
- Taking is dead (fee 5bp vs <1.5bp gross); slow flow has no edge. phase_done true.

## Session 16 (liquidity & flow, strategies), window all
- 50 mm_calm_triple_flow (+|mm_flow_2s|<.3): +0.2 bps/h; 51 mm_calm_triple_deep (+|mm_second_level|<.1): -0.8; 52 mm_calm_double_wide (.4/.15): -1.4. All far below mm_calm_double (45, +13.0).
- A third calm gate or loosening kills fills/edge; 45's thresholds (.25/.1) look like a local optimum, fragile. Final MM candidate: 45. phase_done true.

## Session 17 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 53 lean_depl_sticky (mm_lean_depl z_in 2, z_out 1.5) and 55 flow_30s_hold (z_in 2.5): 0 fills (z-scaled thresholds unreachable again). 54 obi_weighted_hold (z_in 2.5, z_out .5): 62 fills, gross +0.37bp/fill, net -4.6bp, SR -1.3 (fees 0: +0.43).
- Taking is dead at 5bp fee; no speed strategy can pay. Stop spending on thresholds; phase_done true.

## Session 18 (liquidity & flow, strategies), window all
- 56 mm_calm_double_big (45 with size 1.0): +5.8 bps/h (vs 13.0 at size .5; size doesn't scale linearly). 57 mm_calm_double_mid (.3/.08): +0.2. 58 mm_calm_micro_queue (|micro_dev|<.1 & |queue_depl|<.1): +2.6 (fees 0 +5.6).
- All below 45 (+13.0); 45's thresholds remain a fragile local optimum, nothing new beats it. Final MM candidate: 45. phase_done true.

## Session 19 (speed & information, strategies), train window
- 59 lean_depl_wide_hold (z_in 1.5, z_out 1.0): 0 fills (even 1.5 unreachable). 60 block_flow_sticky (z 2/1): 1362 fills, gross -0.37bp/fill, SR -5.7. 61 obi_fast_sticky (z 1.5/1.0): 15.8k fills, gross -0.14bp, SR -6.3.

# DATA: tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01

File `all.parquet`, sha256 `009c1ecc735ec5a7`.
Clock: receive. Grid: 100ms steps, 863,999 points, 2026-10-01 00:00:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01 23:59:59.800000+00:00; warm-up 5min.

Scoring windows (warm-up removed):
- train [2026-10-01T00:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T12:00:00+00:00)
- val [2026-10-01T12:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T18:00:00+00:00)
- test [2026-10-01T18:05:00+00:00, 2026-10-01T23:59:59.900000+00:00)

## A thinned file

For every grid point g this file keeps the last book row at or before each of the stamps g, g + 50 ms, and drops the rest; the judge reads the book only there, so the panel, the fills and every forward return are what the raw file would give. Each kept book row carries `n`, the raw updates it stands for, so `cum_book` counts them all. Trades are summed per side between the panel's reads: one row per side and step at the stamp of that side's last trade, `qty` the side's total, `price` its volume-weighted price and `n` its number of trades. Volumes, notionals, trade counts and the side of the last trade are exact at every grid point; `price` and `qty` of the last trade are the step's per-side VWAP and total, not one print.

Reads at other stamps would see the kept row before them, so the judge leaves out the horizons and offsets the file cannot serve: decay horizons under one step that do not end on a kept stamp, and markout offsets likewise. Lead-lag inside one step is in the raw-file section, where it was measured before thinning.

## Streams

Gaps are between distinct timestamps; `stale_share` is the share of grid points whose latest event is older than one grid step. On this thinned file they describe the kept rows, not the market.

| stream | instrument | rows | duplicate_rows | events_per_s | median_gap_ms | p90_gap_ms | stale_share |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| book | SOLUSDT_PERP | 1,222,332 | 0 | 14.15 | 55.89 | 128.3 | 0.1198 |
| funding | SOLUSDT_PERP | 3 | 0 | 3.472e-05 | 2.88e+07 | 2.88e+07 | 1 |
| trades | SOLUSDT_PERP | 1,953,688 | 1,105,965 | 9.812 | 0.006 | 335.9 | 0.7478 |

The cross-stream lags and trade stamps of the raw file are in the raw-file section at the end; on the kept rows they would measure the thinning.

## The touch stream

The fill engine reads every top-of-book row of SOLUSDT_PERP from the touch file `all.touch.parquet` (11,281,918 rows here), in ticks of 0.01, and each trade at its own stamp; features never see it. Over this workspace's rows:

| measure | value |
|---|---|
| mid, median; tick | 117.855; 0.01 = 0.849 bps |
| spread one tick wide, share of time; two ticks | 99.99%; 0.01% |
| book rows (a second); distinct stamps | 11,281,918 (131); 8,314,782 |
| trades (a second) | 1,953,688 (22.6) |
| displayed at the touch, median bid; ask; bid in USD | 700.6; 616.2; 82,575 |
| falls of the best bid; traded out; pulled; partly | 21,886; 85.7%; 0.1%; 14.1% |
| median time between changes of the best bid price | 502 ms |
| rows at an unchanged bid price; of them with the bid's size changed | 11,237,571; 5,721,926 |

A fall of the best bid is traded out when the sells at the old price from 100 ms before its last row to the fall reach the size it showed, pulled when there were none, and partly each otherwise. Where most levels are traded out, a quote at the back of the touch fills when the level is swept; where many are pulled, the two queue models disagree most.

## Caveats

- Rows with identical timestamps resolve by file order, last wins.
- Which instruments are in the file, and why, is for the user to own.
- Receive clock: a lead of one stream over another can be market lead or feed delay; these numbers cannot tell them apart.

- train: 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01T12:00:00+00:00

- test: 2026-10-01T18:05:00+00:00 to 2026-10-01T23:59:59.900000+00:00

This workspace holds all of the data; `--window` takes any of these names, `all` or `START/END`.

## The raw files behind tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01.parquet

Built by `blinded demo mm` from the Tardis free day 2026-10-01: the SOLUSDT_PERP USD-M perpetual (`binance-futures` `book_ticker`, `trades`, `book_snapshot_5` and `derivative_ticker` of SOLUSDT), every stamp Tardis's `local_timestamp`, the recorder's receive clock, the first 24 hours of the day. Tardis files have no checksum; their sizes and SHA-256 are these:

| file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| binance-futures_book_ticker_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 95,939,166 | `17b1334b010bed81` |
| binance-futures_trades_2026-10-01_SOLUSDT.csv.gz | 14,394,837 | `d45cdff8c386ff50` |

The data file keeps the book rows a read at a grid point or at a grid point plus 50 ms returns (a 100 ms grid from midnight), each with `n`, the raw rows it stands for, and levels 1 to 4 of the snapshot as-of its stamp; every trade at its own stamp with the touch as received; and the day's funding settlements, each the rate of the last `derivative_ticker` row that names it, available 1 s after it. The touch file `tardis-binance-solusdt-perp-mm-2026-10-01.touch.parquet` holds every two-sided `book_ticker` row, prices in ticks of 0.01; only the fill engine reads it. Tick 0.01 and lot 0.01 from Binance's exchangeInfo (read 19 Oct 2026); every book price is a whole number of ticks.
